findingClass: the site republishes a website's transcription of the offer document instead of the document itself — the document's share of provenance rows on printed offer-term fields collapses
failThreshold: document-sourced (source='DRHP') provenance rows are under 5% of all non-ADMIN provenance rows across issueSize, faceValue, priceRangeMin/Max, lotSize, min_investment, issue_price, fresh_issue_size, offer_for_sale_size, registrar, leadManagers, companyName
unverifiableWhen: field_sources is unreadable, or no provenance rows exist on any printed offer-term field
